motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of the June 24, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting. Commissioner Whiting sec…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to approve the minutes of the June 24, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting. Commissioner Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: June 24 commission minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of its June 24, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: This makes the written record of the last meeting official. You will not notice any change.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Site Plan Code Amendments, EMMC 17.00. Com…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Site Plan Code Amendments, EMMC 17.00. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rewrite of the site plan rules in city code
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council adopt changes to the city's site plan rules in chapter 17 of the municipal code.
motions.impact: Developers and builders who file site plans would work under the revised rules if the council adopts them. The motion does not describe the changes.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Amended Preliminary Plat Marketplace 4, in…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Amended Preliminary Plat Marketplace 4, including the condition to correct the minor red lines in the final plat review. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Revised lot layout for Marketplace 4
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve an amended preliminary plat for Marketplace 4, with minor map corrections to be made before the final plat.
motions.impact: This is a draft of how the land in Marketplace 4 is divided, and the council still has to approve it. The motion does not say what changed from the earlier version.

motions.item_title: Table Item 7.C., Animal, Exceptions, Public Hearings, and Appeals Code Amendment, until the Jul…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to table Item 7.C., Animal, Exceptions, Public Hearings, and Appeals Code Amendment, until the July 22, 2025, meeting. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Animal and appeals code changes put off to July 22
motions.summary: The commission delayed until its July 22, 2025 meeting a decision on code changes covering animals, exceptions, public hearings and appeals.
motions.impact: The current rules stay as they are for now. The record does not say what the proposed changes would do.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Meta/Available Storage Cell Tower Site Pla…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Meta/Available Storage Cell Tower Site Plan. Commissioner Fox seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Cell tower at Available Storage
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve the site plan for a Meta cell tower at Available Storage.
motions.impact: Nothing is built on this vote. The City Council makes the final call on the tower, and neighbors of the storage site have the most at stake.
